title: Set my agent instructions
description: Set the caller's personal agent instructions: markdown that PostHog cloud agents load after the project instructions in Tasks runs the caller starts. Autonomous runs never load them. Anyone who continues a task the caller started can see them, so they must not hold anything private. Replaces the stored text; send an empty string to clear. Read the current text with tasks-me-config-list first, and send the full new text, not a diff.

methodDocumentation.text: Set your personal instructions, which PostHog cloud agents load in Tasks runs you start, after the project instructions. Autonomous runs never get them. Anyone who continues a task you started can see them, so leave out anything private. Send an empty string to clear.
